jobs.title: GWM Finance Intern
jobs.description:
Are you interest in Finance? Do you have an eye for detail and have a strong analytical skillset?
We are looking for an intern to:

• prepare weekly and monthly standard reporting for head quarter
• develop analytical controls and integrated reconciliation spreadsheets and processes
• track banker performance at client and product level
• support end users on Business Intelligence tools, supporting on Dashboards preparation/correction and on the tool administrative management
• automate manual processes and assist in the technological development of the financial area
• introduce process improvements and implement financial best practices

The GWM Finance Intern is responsible for providing support with analysis and insight of WM results in coordination with the broader Finance team.
This role will give you the opportunity to build a strong knowledge base across multiple finance specialist areas including accounting, product control and tax planning.
You’ll also support on technical routines related to business intelligence tools as Qlik Sense and Alteryx.

jobs.title: Process and Quality Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you incredibly organized with an eye for detail? Do you have a high client service orientation and a high risk awareness? Do you like working with colleagues across the organization and are you good with stakeholder management? We're looking for someone like that to:
– Act as an Onboarding & KYC Advisor to client advisor on onboarding and Periodic KYC Review (PKR) cases across the WM. Understand and articulate KYC requirements and work with client advisor through the onboarding and PKR processes.
– Be proactive and respond timely to market and business partner’s queries. Facilitate exceptional handling on risk-based approach, and coordinate with Business and Financial Crime / Compliance for signoff.
Review background check screening on the client, provide support on client profile with client advisor, and gather corroboration evidence material where available. Support client advisor to ensure regulatory compliance of submitted materials from client and client advisor themself.
– Handle Periodic KYC Review (PKR) case review from start to end, including client profile updates after consulting with client advisor. Further, perform KYC profile checking activities linked to client onboarding requests and ensure client KYC information consistency with PKR Quality Checks.
– Support client advisor on non-KYC aspects of PKR (i.e. file conversion for archival, raise additional name search request to middle office, escalate for Due Diligence Officer (DDO) review, PKR case manager management.
• – Think flexibly to propose new ideas and contribute to continuous improvement of processes and services.
• – Be-able to act as mentor for junior teammates and cascade management message in an effective and accurate manner
• – Be a trusted partner of market as well as other business partners.

jobs.title: Depositary Risk & Framework Specialist
jobs.description:
Do you know AIFMD & UCITS V regulations? Do you know how to solve problems and increase efficiencies?

You demonstrate a strong expertise in depositary business and the funds industry more broadly and you are used to senior management exposure in a fast moving banking environment.

We're looking for Depositary Risk & Framework Specialist to:

• Lead projects, including client integration, service delivery and sales support
• Support the depositary management team with technical considerations that may require an additional level of judgement
• Conduct, with appropriate support, due diligence oversight reviews on the Central Administrators, AIFMs and the Custodian Banks including preliminary risk assessment, due diligence questionnaire and standard pack documentation review, and any other pertinent documentation review
• Support and maintain Data requirements (Fund onboarding as well as regulatory development) in coordination with relevant functions

jobs.description:
Are you interested in generating new business? Are you strongly interested in the financial industry in particular investments? Are you tech- and data-savvy? Do you work accurately? We are looking for you!

As part of our RFP team, you’ll help respond to detailed client questionnaires that showcase our products, people, and investment strategies. These responses are key to winning new business and maintaining strong client relationships.

You’ll manage RFPs end-to-end, working with large datasets, automating repetitive tasks, and presenting insights clearly. A structured, analytical mindset and a willingness to learn are essential. While deep technical skills aren’t required, being comfortable with data analytics tools (see “Your Experience and Skills”) will help you deliver faster, more insightful responses.

The main tasks of your role are:
• To co-ordinate and produce accurate, timely RFPs, RFIs (Requests for Information) and DDQs (Due Diligence Questionnaires) for prospect clients and existing clients according to internal brand/style guidelines and compliance regulations.
• To collaborate closely with portfolio managers, investment specialists and subject matter experts to improve RFP answers, ensure key messages are understood, and present our capabilities in the most compelling way possible.
• To ensure the RFP database is kept up-to-date and accurate, and quality continually improved
• To help the team identifying and implementing digital solutions

As part of our RFP team, you’ll help respond to detailed client questionnaires that showcase our products, people, and investment strategies. These responses are key to winning new business and maintaining strong client relationships.

You’ll manage RFPs end-to-end, working with large datasets, automating repetitive tasks, and presenting insights clearly. A structured, analytical mindset and a willingness to learn are essential. While deep technical skills aren’t required, being comfortable with data analytics tools (see “Your Experience and Skills”) will help you deliver faster, more insightful responses.

The main tasks of your role are:
• To co-ordinate and produce accurate, timely RFPs, RFIs (Requests for Information) and DDQs (Due Diligence Questionnaires) for prospect clients and existing clients according to internal brand/style guidelines and compliance regulations.
• To collaborate closely with portfolio managers, investment specialists and subject matter experts to improve RFP answers, ensure key messages are understood, and present our capabilities in the most compelling way possible.
• To ensure the RFP database is kept up-to-date and accurate, and quality continually improved
• To help the team identifying and implementing digital solutions

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Are you excited to work with a global team with diverse backgrounds and talents? Can you apply your technical skills to help quantify business risks? Do you enjoy the challenge of driving business impact through analytics and are looking for an opportunity to lead innovation?

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to:

• engage in audits to analyze data using traditional machine learning or Large Language Models to uncover trends, patterns, or anomalies for auditors to investigate further.
• work collaboratively with stakeholders to assist in risk assessments and highlight high-risk areas for deep dives.
• clearly communicate complex insights derived from analytics to senior stakeholders in a manner that is both engaging and impactful.
• stay up to date with advancements in AI, ML, and NLP to implement cutting-edge solutions, such as working with the latest Large Language Models (LLMs).
• provide auditors with training and support, as required, to effectively use data-driven tools and solutions.

jobs.title: Social Media Creative Specialist
jobs.description:
We are looking for an innovative Social Media Content Creator to join our corporate communications team. In this role, you will be responsible for crafting engaging social media content and producing high-quality videos that amplify our corporate messaging across our branded and C-Suite channels.
Our ideal candidate is a creative, detail-oriented, professional who is passionate about staying ahead of digital trends. An organized self-starter with a desire to grow in a corporate environment with senior visibility.
You will:
• Create, edit, and publish compelling social media posts across platforms. It includes but is not limited to: Campaign/idea pitching and briefing, story board creation, editing of videos, as well as post copywriting, infographic creation, graphic design.
• Develop short- and long-form serialized video content to enhance brand visibility.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to ensure messaging consistency.
• Report on performance and analyze data to optimize future content performance.
• Stay ahead of emerging social media tools and trends, providing period updates to stakeholder teams on future trends.

jobs.title: Credit Risk Officer - Hedge Funds
jobs.description:
Are you naturally curious and ambitious? Do you have sharp analytical skills and a background in counterparty credit risk in hedge funds?

We’re looking for a Credit Risk Officer like you who can:

• evaluate counterparty credit risk based on an understanding of the hedge fund and family office risk management techniques, trading strategies, and infrastructure, as well as a number of other quantitative and qualitative measures of credit worthiness. This will include client due diligence visits for onsite evaluations.
• hold delegated personal authority (within established risk-based limits) to approve new positions or to make recommendations to higher authority levels within Credit. The candidate will be expected to interact with the business units in relation to transactions to ensure the risk fit UBS's ultimate appetite in the sector.
• evaluate transactional risks associated with OTC derivatives, securities financing, exchange traded derivatives, banking products and structured transactions
• prepare, as well as review and approve, written counterparty annual reviews/transactional credit proposals drawing conclusions relating to credit assessment, risk appetite, exposure drivers and business prospects
• lead trading documentation negotiation including ISDA/CSA, Prime Brokerage and Repo Agreements
• ensure all regulatory requests, audit items and operational risk issues are dealt with in a disciplined, timely and efficient manner
• perform ad hoc credit risk analysis and participate in portfolio reviews to identify risk developments or concentrations

jobs.title: Team Administrator
jobs.description:
The Team Administrator will lead operational, client service, and administrative functions for a high-performing financial advisor team serving ultra-high-net-worth clients. This individual serves as the operational backbone of the team—ensuring exceptional execution, leading risk and compliance initiatives, and a seamless client experience. The ideal candidate is a seasoned and decisive operations professional with deep knowledge of wealth management processes, strong leadership capabilities, an ability to navigate firm processes efficiently, and who can drive innovation with a technology-forward mindset.

Key Responsibilities:

• Client Service & Relationship Support: Deliver white-glove service for clients, partnering closely with the financial advisors to anticipate client needs and act discretion and responsiveness.

• Account Administration & Transactions: Oversee and execute a range of important administrative tasks including account openings, account maintenance, and transfers across multiple account types and entities, wires, disbursements, journals, and cash movements with precision and appropriate controls. Ensure timely and accurate processing of all client account paperwork

• Team Leadership & Development: Manage and develop operations and client service team members including setting priorities, workflow standards, and performance expectations for the operations team. Build a high accountability culture focused on excellence, efficiency, and client satisfaction and lead by example in a dynamic, high-expectation, in-office team environment

• Technology, Systems & Innovation: Serve as the team’s operations technology lead, with strong knowledge of platforms, systems, and workflows. Be the team champion for implementing firm-approved tools, platforms, and AI-driven solutions to drive efficiency, reduce risk, and enhance client experience

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law should be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: Trade Surveillance Operations Analyst

Your role :

Do you like financial markets?
Are you good at handling and interpreting large data sets?
Are you analytical and enjoy investigating financial transactions, understanding trading strategies and making sense of the unusual trading activity?
Are you able to think independently and express your opinions and ideas confidently?

We are looking for a Trade Surveillance Analyst in an individual contributor role with experience in the following:

• Performing automated and manual market conduct surveillance activities across Investment Bank and Wealth Management division.
• Analyzing instances of potentially suspicious activities flagged by our systems.
• Engaging with business stakeholders on the market conduct-related escalations and other matters.
• Driving continuous process improvements and contributing to strategic projects and automation/optimization initiatives.

• Conducting information barrier trade surveillance for firm, customer, and employee personal account dealing (PAD) Monitor the flow of material nonpublic information (MNPI) to detect potential breaches of the firm's Information Barrier Policy, restricted list, and insider trading.

• This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

titleByLocale.en: Global Wealth Management Marketing Strategist, APAC
titleByLocale.it: Global Wealth Management Marketing Strategist, APAC
titleByLocale.de: Global Wealth Management Marketing Strategist, APAC
titleByLocale.fr: Global Wealth Management Marketing Strategist, APAC

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Marketing Strategist to support the UBS Global Wealth Management (GWM) business across the APAC region. Working as part of the regional Market Coverage team, you will set a clear, data-informed direction for brand and marketing activation across APAC countries and segments, ensure alignment with divisional priorities, and orchestrate partnerships that amplify growth, reputation, and client impact.

Scope & Impact
• Work with the GWM regional marketing heads for Greater China, SEA/Japan and Australia and APAC Head of Marketing to shape the end-to-end Brand & Marketing planning process, integrating funnel goals and in-market priorities to deliver measurable outcomes.
• Partner with IB and AM Marketing coverage and Media and Communications teams to foster stronger cross-divisional coordination and One Bank brand and marketing initiatives
• Provide strategic guidance on value propositions, go-to-market strategies, key growth projects in partnership with the business and ensure narratives remain coherent and client-centric.
• Lead a team specialised in digital client acquisition marketing efforts, collaborating across functions, divisions and external partners to design and execute innovative campaigns that drive awareness, interest and engagement in new and existing audiences
• Work hand in hand with Marketing Excellence Labs (MELs), leveraging their expertise and insight for the benefit of the APAC region to deliver efficient and effective campaigns that grow existing clients and generate leads.
• Act as a senior marketing advisor with an increased focus on Australia as a new and valuable GWM book and where IB is already strong and Japan where the business across the Group is ambitious to grow further.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Planning
• Help define GWM’s multi-year marketing strategy and annual plan, including objectives by funnel stage and region, target-setting approach, and governance cadence.
• Translate strategic priorities into integrated campaign roadmaps, briefing requirements, and KPIs; ensure consistency between top-funnel brand goals and mid/bottom-funnel performance targets.
• Maintain a live portfolio view of programs, reallocating resources to the highest-impact opportunities amid constrained budgets and competitive noise.

Regional & Cross-Divisional Support
• Provide an objective APAC-wide perspective to avoid fragmented approaches and ensure cohesive regional strategy.
• Support a cross-divisional construct offering strategic advice and partnering with on-the-ground teams to deliver integrated outcomes. Seek out efficiencies by collaborating with IB, AM and P&C divisions to collectively achieve positive business and client outcomes.
• Bring to life regional on-the-ground knowledge of client behaviours and market dynamics for the benefit of all APAC country plans.

Briefing & Creative Excellence
• Co-create creative/media briefs that demand non-traditional ideas capable of breaking through clutter and driving earned amplification; steward agencies / internal teams to that quality bar.
• Ensure briefs specify funnel requirements by market and articulate how partners will support GWM to align targets and evaluation frameworks.

Measurement & Optimization
• Set and socialize measurement frameworks linking funnel progression to accelerate acquisition and business outcomes; run quarterly reviews to optimize mix, creative, and partnerships against target deltas.
• Champion test-and-learn performance marketing (new formats/channels, neuroscience or message testing) to continuously sharpen propositions and creative effectiveness.

• Provide strategic guidance on value propositions, go-to-market strategies, key growth projects in partnership with the business and ensure narratives remain coherent and client-centric.
• Lead a team specialised in digital client acquisition marketing efforts, collaborating across functions, divisions and external partners to design and execute innovative campaigns that drive awareness, interest and engagement in new and existing audiences
• Work hand in hand with Marketing Excellence Labs (MELs), leveraging their expertise and insight for the benefit of the APAC region to deliver efficient and effective campaigns that grow existing clients and generate leads.

Strategy & Planning

jobs.title: Trade Surveillance Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Do you like financial markets?
Are you good at handling and interpreting large data sets?
Are you analytical and enjoy investigating financial transactions, understanding trading strategies and making sense of the unusual trading activity?
Are you able to think independently and express your opinions and ideas confidently?

We are looking for a Trade Surveillance Analyst in an individual contributor role with experience in the following:

• Performing automated and manual market conduct surveillance activities across Investment Bank and Wealth Management division.
• Analyzing instances of potentially suspicious activities flagged by our systems.
• Engaging with business stakeholders on the market conduct-related escalations and other matters.
• Driving continuous process improvements and contributing to strategic projects and automation/optimization initiatives.

• Conducting information barrier trade surveillance for firm, customer, and employee personal account dealing (PAD) Monitor the flow of material nonpublic information (MNPI) to detect potential breaches of the firm's Information Barrier Policy, restricted list, and insider trading.

• This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

• keep up to date with latest development best practices and proactively manage technical debt
• implement and manage infrastructure as code using tools like Terraform and ARM templates
• monitor and optimize the performance of Azure resources and services

jobs.description:
Are you a team player? Do you want to proactively go the extra mile to help clients with us? Do you enjoy supporting a group of experienced Client Advisors in delivering an excellent client experience?

We are looking for you to join our Wealth Management Private Client sector as a Client Account Manager to help us provide efficient and high quality support to our Clients and Client Advisors.

• support Wealth Management Client Advisors and our clients in their daily business
• provide a broad spectrum of high quality services, such as client meeting preparation, risk and client servicing tasks (e.g. account opening, account maintenance, credit) and support with other complex client-related processes, with specialisation of specific client servicing processes from time to time
• have contact to internal and external clients, build rapport and work closely with internal partners in handling tasks end to end
• manage complex troubleshooting as required in the course of handling tasks
• work in a team of highly motivated experienced Client Account Managers, and help to continuously improve processes through regular knowledge exchange (i.e. sharing lessons learned and best practices)
• follow and adhere to the UBS code of ethics and the relevant cross-border regulations
